capabilities: Chat with local coding agent CLIs from a multi-tab sidebar with saved, searchable, resumable conversations
Execute inline prompts in the editor with real-time word-level diff previews
Compose prompts with @note and @folder mentions, drag-and-drop vault items, and image attachments
Manage shared workspace resources such as Skills, MCP servers, subagents, and commands
Configure provider connections, custom Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and secrets in Obsidian SecretStorage
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a troubleshooting FAQ (macOS GUI apps not inheriting shell environment variables, Kimi CLI login) and an Afdian sponsorship link.
intentEvidence: Codian is built upon the foundation of Claudian, created by Yishen Tu.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run local AI coding agents against vault notes while keeping provider-native sessions, authentication, and permissions.

relations.evidence: Codian is built upon the foundation of Claudian, created by Yishen Tu.

requires.name: Provider CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, Grok, OpenCode, or Pi) on $PATH
API keys or auth tokens for custom Anthropic-compatible endpoints

summary: Multi-provider AI agent workspace that connects local coding agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Grok, OpenCode, Pi) to your vault for chat and inline editing.
